Interface text keys

Source: R/texts.R
aa_text_keys.Rd

Interface text keys

Usage

aa_text_keys()

Value

A vector of key names that can be overridden in aa_texts().

Examples

aa_text_keys()
#>   [1] "login_title"                   "login_label"                  
#>   [3] "password_label"                "login_button"
